_meta.note: Captured off the wire from dsh --profile acp (package @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, the release the side-read-only capture used; the bridge reports agentInfo.version 0.0.1) with Kiro Crew gate plugin composed through a --patch file carrying the same four rows the client writes, under DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=workspace-write, driven over stdio against a loopback Messages-API model stub with a throwaway HOME, so no real model or credential was involved. session/new carried one stdio element named probe whose tools/list answers one tool, lookup. The stub model calls mcp__probe__lookup once with {owner, issue_number}. The tool_call frame titles the call mcp__probe__lookup with rawInput equal to those arguments; the session/request_permission frame names only the toolCallId; the stub server log showed tools/call params.arguments equal to that rawInput. Reductions: the session id is synthetic, the scratch directory reads ~, usage_update frames are dropped, each select keeps only its current value.
